import {elapsed} from './time.mjs';
export function solve(x){const pending=new Map(),out=[];for(const e of x.events){if(e.kind==='start')pending.set(e.id,e.time);else if(e.kind==='end'&&pending.has(e.id)){const start=pending.get(e.id);pending.delete(e.id);if(e.time>=start)out.push({id:e.id,elapsed:elapsed(start,e.time)});}}return out;}
